ranking.reason: The job is simple to grasp from an ad (a private, locked journal that never loses entries), and the sourced complaints about lost years of entries and no lock point to a strong, emotionally specific need.
The no-bank-login, no-data-sales hook is a sharp trust message, but many people who want spending visibility will still expect bank linking, which weakens the tap rate.
The complaints describe bugs in existing bill apps rather than a distinct promise, and a bill list is a generic utility, so an ad gives less reason to tap.
